# Input Password

```tsx
import { InputPassword } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A password field built on Input Text, with Button View to show or hide the characters. Mirrors the Figma Input Password component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled × Error.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<InputPassword {...args} icon={getLeadingIcon({ showIcon, icon })} />
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Password component: Input Text with Button View in the Action Inset slot, which toggles between hidden and visible characters.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputPasswordProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showPasswordLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of Button View while the password is hidden. |
| `hidePasswordLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of Button View while the password is visible. |

## Types

`InputPasswordProps`

## Rules

- Import `InputPassword` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
